admission.justification: The durable ledger was weighed and rejected as self-defeating, and the choice binds the writer contract against future ledgers.

alternatives.option: Count unwritten events per tool server in memory, carried by the next written event and cleared only after that write succeeds.
alternatives.reason: It counts as well as one process can without promising across a crash.

alternatives.option: Keep a durable file ledger of failed writes.
alternatives.reason: The ledger write fails exactly when it is needed.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A failure-proof side channel for counts ever exists.

consequences: Counts are lost with the server; nothing is promised across a crash or while storage cannot be written.
context: Architect F02 ruling: a durable ledger of failed writes would have to be written to the storage that just failed.
decider: Architect, F02 ruling on MIK-R114@v1, adopted by the leaf.
